content: मसूरकः A pillow. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A kind of ornament on Indraʼs banner. .²2 A variety of pearls; <ls>Kau. A. 2. 11. 29</ls>. .²3 A lintel, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the piece of timber or stone that covers an opening and supports a weight above it; मसूरकमधिष्ठानं वस्त्वाधारं धरातलम् <ls>Kāmikāgama 55. 202</ls>.
